name: hud_ui_net_exit_resume_widget_on_show_preview
description: HudUiNetExitPanel_ResumeWidget::OnShowPreview claims preview input capture, optionally restores mouse focus, and then shows the base ZRD preview.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x41bf40 validates that an inactive preview pushes a null bind-map context, sets mouse binding slot 1 to command 0, checks zInp::GetJoystickOption, restores reticle and saved input focus only when joystick is disabled, sets previewInputCaptureActive to 1, and always calls HudUiZrdWidget::ShowPreview.

The native smoke patches the input, reticle, SetInputFocus, and ShowPreview calls; it verifies the first joystick-disabled activation, verifies an already-active repeat only calls ShowPreview, and verifies the joystick-enabled branch skips reticle/focus restoration while still claiming preview capture.
